title: What would you like to see on a survey?
content: I'm gonna make a survey, so everyone chime in with their questions they want to know about everyone here. So far I've got: Did you experience trauma as a child? What part of the world do you live in? Were you in a gifted program as a child? Are you neurodivergent? Have you had any paranormal experiences? UFO sightings? Do you experience the Mandela effect? Do you engage in meditation? Are you a lucid dreamer? Have you ever had a near death experience? Do you have synchronicities in your life? Do you have sleep paralysis? Have you ever seen a shadow person? Do you believe these dreams to be paranormal or a shared dreamscape? Have you ever had one of these dreams where you see a figure who seems to be in charge of the dream? Do you seem to be moving a lot in these dreams? Moving into or out of dorms, hotel rooms, apartments, or houses? Do you frequently feel like you are in a mission in these dreams? Do you have dreams in which you have to complete dangerous and physically impossible missions which seems to test real world physics? Do you have dreams where there are ghosts and/or monsters that you have to fight? Are you frequently evading and sneaking off to your favorite places? Add your questions and critique mine.
